# Match-Up!🍵 
A dessert-themed memory game built in MakeCode Arcade.

Link to Prototype: [https://arcade.makecode.com/S04960-74764-87539-01557]

## General Information  
*Match-Up!* is a memory game where players flip dessert plates to find matching pairs. Designed with accessibility and playful aesthetics in mind, the game blends visual storytelling with cognitive challenge.

- **Problem it solves:** Encourages memory recall and attention through interactive gameplay.  
- **Purpose:** To explore game logic, sprite design, and user experience in MakeCode Arcade.  
- **Why I built it:** As part of my final-year Communication degree at UTS, I wanted to create a game that’s both technically sound and emotionally engaging.

---

## Technologies Used  
- **MakeCode Arcade** – visual block and JavaScript-based game development  
- **JavaScript (MakeCode variant)** – for custom logic and sprite control  
- **Pixel Art Editor** – for designing custom sprites and backgrounds

---

## Features  
- Flip-to-reveal memory matching mechanic  
- Countdown timer for added difficulty  
- Highlight cursor with blinking animation for accessibility  
- Custom sprite design with picnic-themed desserts  
- Responsive feedback and win screen

## Setup  
No installation required — playable directly in browser via MakeCode Arcade.  
To edit or remix the game:  
1. Go to [MakeCode Arcade](https://arcade.makecode.com/)  
2. Import the project using the shared link  
3. Modify sprites, logic, or UI as needed

---

## Usage  
- Use arrow keys to navigate the grid.
```ts
// ARROW KEY NAVIGATION
controller.left.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    if (selectedCol > 0) {
        selectedCol += -1
        highlightSelected()
    
        if (cursorHighlight) {
            cursorHighlight.setPosition(plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].x, plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].y)
        }
    }
})

controller.right.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    if (selectedCol < 4) {
        selectedCol += 1
        highlightSelected()

        if (cursorHighlight) {
            cursorHighlight.setPosition(plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].x, plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].y)
        }
    }
})

controller.up.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    if (selectedRow > 0) {
        selectedRow += -1
        highlightSelected()

        if (cursorHighlight) {
            cursorHighlight.setPosition(plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].x, plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].y)
        }
    }
})

controller.down.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    if (selectedRow < 3) {
        selectedRow += 1
        highlightSelected()

        if (cursorHighlight) {
            cursorHighlight.setPosition(plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].x, plates[selectedRow][selectedCol].y)
        }
    }
})
```

- Match two identical desserts to score a pair.
```ts
// CHECK FOR MATCH
function checkForMatch () {
    first = revealedPlates[0]
    second = revealedPlates[1]
    firstIndex = findPlateIndex(first)
    secondIndex = findPlateIndex(second)
    if (faceUps[firstIndex].equals(faceUps[secondIndex])) {
        matchedPlates.push(first)
        matchedPlates.push(second)

        // Add confetti or sparkle effect
        first.startEffect(effects.confetti, 1000)
        second.startEffect(effects.confetti, 1000)
        music.baDing.play()
        
    } else {
        first.setImage(faceDownImage)
        second.setImage(faceDownImage)
        flipped[firstIndex] = false
        flipped[secondIndex] = false
        music.zapped.play()
    }
```

- Complete all matches before the timer runs out!
```ts
// FLIP LOGIC
function flipSelectedPlate() {
    if (!timerStarted) {
        timerStarted = true
        info.startCountdown(90) // Starts a timer
    }
```
